title: The Prettiest Girl in the Village

instruction.text: Find all the superlative adjectives in this text.

atoms.b: There was once a girl named Bianca who lived in the ((most beautiful)) cottage with the ((greenest)) grass and the ((brightest)) flowers.

Bianca was considered to be the ((prettiest)) girl in the village and everyone was enamoured by her gorgeous smile. Not only was Bianca beautiful, but she was also the ((smartest)) girl in the school.
Due to all these incredible attributes, the three ((most handsome)) boys in her town Louis, Martin and Max tried their ((hardest)) to impress Bianca.

instruction.text: Find all the comparative adjectives in this text.

atoms.b: The boys first started by buying her gifts. Max bought her a pretty necklace. Louis bought her an even ((prettier)) one, but it was without a doubt that Martin’s necklace was the prettiest.

Despite all the gifts, Bianca paid no attention to the boys. The boys tried ((harder)) and they worked ((longer)) to buy her ((bigger)) presents in order to get her attention. All Bianca wanted was for them to be friends!

instruction.text: Find all the adjectives in this text.

atoms.b: And they did just that! In the end, the ((beautiful)) girl and the ((kind)) boys became friends and lived happily in the ((charming)) village.
